description: Computes one anchored step of one card and returns the state it lands on, in decimals and exact hex, with its cryptographic proof (sha256_seal) and a receipt. parameters holds the card's phase fields, its load fields and dt_s, as describe_card gives them. A step whose request or whose landing state is outside the card is refused in one sentence, with the refusal's name in round brackets when it has one, and no proof is issued for that state. With from, the step starts from a sealed run, which is computed again first. On this open connection one address holds at most 1 physics permit at a time, and long work (a solve, a plan of runs or of solves, a run of more than 10000 steps, or a verification that computes one again) runs 1 at a time. A call that finds no permit or no place is answered "Too many concurrent physics tasks." and nothing waits: the same call sent later is answered once one is free. An answer is waited for 60 seconds, and long work is stopped there.

inputSchema.description: One anchored step. The shape of parameters depends on the pair: describe_card gives it.

card.description: The card of the pair, as list_cards names it.

domain.description: The domain of the pair, as list_cards names it.

from.description: Optional: a sealed run to start from, as run_trajectory takes it.

parameters.description: The step's inputs: the card's phase fields, its load fields and dt_s, each a number (a vector field is an array of three numbers), and no other key. describe_card gives the fields of the pair, with each unit and bound. A required field left out is refused as InputMissing, in a sentence that names the field, and a card the engine does not serve as UnknownCard; nothing is filled in.

name: compute_step
title: Compute step
